title: Tanker report - Week 42
summary:
Clean
LR2
The TC1 75kt MEG/Japan index climbed by 47 points this week to WS986, with the corresponding Baltic round-trip TCE gaining $14,800 to $285,400/day. For the TC20 90kt MEG/UK-Continent run, the index rose by $2.73 million to $21.24 million, corresponding to $332,000/day on Baltic round trip. The TC15 80kt Mediterranean/East index added $2.40 million to finish at $16.40 million, with the Baltic round-trip TCE improving by $32,100 to $175,000/day.

children.title: VLCC
children.summary: The VLCC rates on the Baltic Exchange routes fell back this week. The TD3C route (270,000mt Middle East Gulf to China) dropped 37.5 points to WS1,281.25, giving a daily round-trip TCE of $1,370,193 for the standard Baltic VLCC.

children.title: Suezmax
children.summary: In the Suezmax sector, the market weakened across the Baltic Exchange routes, except in the Black Sea. The rate for the 130,000mt Nigeria/UK Continent voyage (TD20) fell 76 points to WS920, which gives a daily round-trip TCE of about $522,600.

children.title: Aframax
children.summary: In the North Sea, the rate for the 80,000mt Cross-UK Continent route (TD7) dropped by 36 points to WS590, giving a daily round-trip TCE of just under $486,400 basis Hound Point to Wilhelmshaven. In the Mediterranean, the rate for 80,000mt Cross-Mediterranean (TD19) fell 60 points to the WS720 mark.
